# Society for the Advancement of Psychotherapy

> A professional organization dedicated to advancing psychotherapy practice, research, education, and advocacy through collaborative leadership and evidence-based innovation.

The Society for the Advancement of Psychotherapy is APA Division 29, serving as a hub for psychotherapy professionals, students, and scholars worldwide. The organization operates through specialized domains focused on practice, education, diversity, social justice, and international collaboration.

## Key Topics

- Psychotherapy Practice
- Professional Development
- Diversity & Inclusion
- Education & Training
- Membership Benefits
- Student Development
- Research & Scholarship
- Social Justice & Advocacy
- International Collaboration
- Mentorship Programs
- Awards & Grants
- Evidence-Based Practice
- Leadership
- Early Career Professionals
- Continuing Education

## Organization Overview

- [Home](https://societyforpsychotherapy.org): Homepage for Society for the Advancement of Psychotherapy (APA Division 29)
- [Domains](https://societyforpsychotherapy.org/domains): Overview of organizational domains covering psychotherapy practice, education, and leadership

## Organizational Domains

- [Professional Practice](https://societyforpsychotherapy.org/domains/professional-practice): Professional practice domain promoting evidence-based psychotherapy practice
- [Education & Training](https://societyforpsychotherapy.org/domains/education-training): Education domain advancing training for psychotherapy practitioners and researchers
- [Science & Scholarship](https://societyforpsychotherapy.org/domains/science-scholarship): Science domain promoting psychotherapy research and bridging research-practice gaps
- [Diversity](https://societyforpsychotherapy.org/domains/diversity): Diversity domain fostering inclusion initiatives for the psychotherapy community
- [Social Justice & Public Policy](https://societyforpsychotherapy.org/domains/social-justice-public-policy): Advocacy domain promoting psychotherapy through legislative and institutional change
- [International](https://societyforpsychotherapy.org/domains/international): International domain fostering cross-cultural psychotherapy advancement globally
- [Early Career Professionals](https://societyforpsychotherapy.org/domains/early-career): Domain supporting new psychotherapy professionals with mentorship and networking
- [Membership](https://societyforpsychotherapy.org/domains/membership): Membership domain fostering vibrant community and professional networking

## Membership & Community

- [Members](https://societyforpsychotherapy.org/members): Members directory gateway to resources, awards, and community information
- [Member Portal](https://societyforpsychotherapy.org/members/member-portal): Member portal for dues, applications, and membership benefit access
- [Fellows](https://societyforpsychotherapy.org/members/fellows): Fellows directory honoring distinguished members in psychotherapy leadership
- [List-Serv](https://societyforpsychotherapy.org/list-serv): Listserv signup for psychotherapy community updates and discussions

## Awards, Grants & Recognition

- [Awards & Grants](https://societyforpsychotherapy.org/members/awards-and-grants): Awards and grants celebrating contributions to psychotherapy advancement
- [Student Grants](https://societyforpsychotherapy.org/student-grants): Student grant opportunities for research, education, and professional development

## Student Resources & Development

- [Student Portal](https://societyforpsychotherapy.org/members/student-portal): Student portal connecting scholars and practitioners for mentorship and resources
- [Student Development Committee](https://societyforpsychotherapy.org/members/student-portal/student-development-committee): Student Development Committee advocating for student perspectives in psychotherapy
- [Internships](https://societyforpsychotherapy.org/internships): Internship guidance including tips, interview prep, and application advice

## Leadership & Governance

- [Leadership Portal](https://societyforpsychotherapy.org/members/leadership-portal): Leadership portal providing governance resources and organizational documents
